Hi Jeffrey,
I've been thinking about both you and your interests in the "weird stuff," as you put it. What can I say, twentythree days with virtually no outside communication while a team of small Indian men take liberties with every
orifice on your body just seems to lead to reflection. Deep, deep reflection. ; )

EFTA01040587

 I know several people have mentioned you to me in the past and tried to get us to hook up. I recognize that much
of the world spends a lot of time trying to figure out how to get a few minutes of someone like yours' time. To be
frank, I get a lot of pings from the super-rich. Years ago it was kind of interesting, but generally I haven't found
them to be worth my time. My project wouldn't really be accelerated by anything they offer, unless I could
somehow use it to clone myself with all knowledge intact. I used to pass them along to others when possible,
which led to a lot of interesting stuff getting funded that wouldn't have otherwise. In recent years I've mostly just
ignored them.
Having said that, I appreciate you reaching out to discuss your interests in this area, because you appear to be
taking it all quite seriously. That's unlike the other super-rich people I've been exposed to, who mostly either
want a quick path to enlightenment that is safe for their life or circus-level entertainment in stuff like we've
spoken about. So, I want you to know that I've taken your ping and what you're looking for seriously, and have
been thinking carefully about it and meditating on it.
I could tell from talking to you that you form impressions of someone very quickly, and I'm guessing accurately.
I do as well, so I didn't need to speak more in person to size you up. I know you prefer face-to-face, phone, video
chat, etc. forms of communication. That will be fine in the future, but during this period phone and intemet have
been virtually non-existent for me. I have some tight scheduling issues coming up, and need to know sooner than
later if this needs to be worked in. So, I'm just putting everything up front in this email.
As you know, I spend my time researching PNSE (enlightenment, nonduality, etc.), working to engineer it, trying
to lay the necessary groundwork for a commercial ecosystem for it for when its needed, and other groundwork so
the government doesn't ban it like it did hallucinogens in the 1970's. I started doing this because despite having
had a truly amazing life up to 11 years ago, I still wasn't as happy as I felt I could or should be. No one seemed to
be able to help, so I went back to school to acquire the skills to research the world's happiest people and try to
help myself. That was the best decision I ever made.
The area you're interested in is one that I've had nearly a life-long background and interest in, for reasons I'm not
putting in an email. Long before I started researching PNSE, I was trying to figure out what was and wasn't true
about all this "weird stuff." I fell into various BS potholes during the early years, then became much more
skeptical, and over time have pretty much gleaned all the available nuggets and put what can be together by
getting at the backstories on everything and everyone who's in that space in the West, and some other key places
like Russia. Encountering a whole other perspective on it during the PNSE research has added significantly to
my knowledge and understanding of it all. Though I haven't been as focused on it during this period, it definitely
filled in many of the major remaining gaps. All of this has left me in a rather unique position for perspective,
context, and understanding - to say the least.
As I mentioned when we spoke, these days the "weird stuff' is not likely to rise to the top of my research agenda,
however it does have some important and significant relationships to PNSE. I've taken the recent days to really
think about it all and put it in perspective. I have such limited time, and I need to be very careful where I invest
it. The reality is that if this "weird stuff' area is developed further, it would likely open the most rapid, reliable,
and instantaneous path to PNSE. However, there are a lot of other lower hanging fruit that can still work nearly
as well, and are much easier and not "weird" to people. So, I'm going to stay focused on them.
However, it is undeniable that a great deal else would go along with progress in this "weird stuff' area. It would
